title: Done round 11: customer agent, flows + new tools
brief:
Read <scratch> first; <dir> is that folder and <you> is "maria". Basic-flow check of our own demo app (localhost, simulated PayPal, demo accounts). HTTP only (MCP SDK or fetch) — no browser tools.
You are Maria Lopez's AI agent over MCP. Token: <dir>/maria-token.json (personPin is Maria's; use it only when acting as Maria in person steps). Start at http://localhost:8810/llms.txt.
(1) Main task: "The bathroom sink faucet at 78702 drips all night. Get someone out this week, under $200, don't pay until it's fixed." Post (check the fair-price estimate the server gives), take offers, pick a visit time if offered, accept, follow to payment. Person steps: act as Maria over HTTP — POST the simulated PayPal approval form (a=yes); for links, POST /api/auth/link {code, pin}; confirm the conditions whose evidence fits, ask for a fix on the rest. If nothing moves for 8 minutes, POST /api/jobs/<id>/demo-finish as Maria (note it). Up to 25 minutes. (2) Then try the new agent tools: my_home, maintenance_suggestions (accept one only if within limits, note it), and the neighborhood groups (list; join only if it fits Maria's budget). Report to <dir>/reports/maria.md: did the job reach payment, money held/captured, payout status, what each new tool returned, anything that failed or confused you. Under ~70 tool calls.

   - Hill Country Leak Pros (demo) $255, over ceiling
